pages.name: Work out 3 − (−2)
pages.task: Work out 3 − (−2) with the marker. Turn it round, then step it.
pages.why: Facing down takes away. −2 is negative, so the marker steps backwards, up to 4 and 5. So 3 − (−2) = 5.

pages.name: Adding its opposite
pages.text: Taking away −2 lands where adding 2 does. So taking away a negative is [[adding its opposite]], and 3 − (−2) = 3 + 2 = 5.

pages.name: Which comes to −4?
pages.why: Start at −6, face down and step backwards 2, up to −5 and −4. Taking away a negative moves you up, but not always above zero, so −6 − (−2) = −4.
